dict.string: Lumen uses AppleScript to read the active tab URL and title from Safari and Chrome for your personal lifelog. No page content is ever collected.
Lumen records periodic location pings so your daily lifelog includes where you were working.
Lumen records periodic location pings so your daily lifelog includes where you were working.
Lumen reads your Focus status (Do Not Disturb / Work / Personal) so your daily lifelog can show when you were in a Focus state. Only the on/off state is recorded, never the reasons or apps.
Lumen uses the microphone for offline 'Hey Lumen' voice interactions and audio queries.
Lumen uses speech recognition to process 'Hey Lumen' voice commands and queries on-device.
